change.description: Add persistent model management, dynamic /v1/models presets, and user-reviewed LiteLLM multi-dimensional price synchronization.
change.release_unit_description: System Models page, managed model catalog migration, dynamic proxy models, legacy price projections, and complete quote persistence.

planned.reasoning: The HTTP changes add management endpoints and dynamic model IDs while preserving existing response fields. The SQLite catalog is additive, but older same-Major binaries do not support dynamic model membership and can discard dynamic enabled IDs when saving proxy settings.

scope_drift.description: Implementation and local validation match the approved contract; no compatibility scope drift was found.

current.reasoning: Public API impact remains patch because the existing entries contract is retained and quotes are additive. Persistent state is minor because the quote table and dynamic model catalog add durable capabilities; the release unit takes the higher persistent-state impact.

verified.reasoning: The stateful SQLite profile verifies migration, deletion suppression after restart, explicit rediscovery with presets disabled, and unchanged historical costs. Public API impact remains patch for additive routes and model IDs; persistent state is minor because earlier same-Major writers do not preserve dynamic enabled IDs.
evidence: cargo test pricing quote parser and transaction selectors: passed
bun run typecheck:web and cd web && bun run build: passed
bun run lint:web: passed with 93 existing warnings
cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check: passed

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing clients may continue reading existing settings fields and /v1/models responses; new management routes and dynamic model IDs are additive.

persistent_state.state_description: SQLite managed model IDs, proxy enabled model IDs, legacy pricing projections, complete pricing_model_quotes rows, and historical invocation costs.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Earlier repository versions with static proxy preset IDs and the existing pricing catalog; direct Major skips are unsupported.
